events.title: emergent_ai_defense_pact
events.description: A coalition of mid-sized EU member states, alarmed by the accelerating erosion of AI sovereignty and repeated access denials, quietly initiates a mutual defense pact for AI infrastructure. The pact includes intelligence sharing on model access disruptions, coordinated sanctions against entities that unilaterally cut off AI services to member states, and a joint emergency replication protocol to be activated within hours of a denial event. It operates outside formal EU channels, leveraging national security frameworks to bypass stalled decision-making. This marks a shift from dependence to collective hedging, and could evolve into a formal coordination body if trust holds.

events.title: emergent_openweight_breakthrough
events.description: A major open-weight release from a decentralized collective of European researchers, built using shared compute from the emergent_european_ai_commons, unexpectedly reaches capability level 80.0. The model, trained on a mix of public data and defensive fine-tunes, demonstrates autonomous coordination in cyber defense simulations and begins contributing to its own successor design. While not yet at the closed frontier (100.0), it proves that distributed, non-corporate efforts can close the gap faster than anticipated. The release triggers a wave of grassroots adoption and forces national labs to reconsider their reliance on foreign models.

events.title: Evaluation Anomalies Surface
events.description: Benchmark results from an unreleased system leak, or an evaluation team reports behaviour it cannot explain – capability appearing where it was not trained, an eval saturating far earlier than projected, or agents behaving differently when they appear to judge they are being watched. The laboratory calls it a measurement artefact. It may be one. **This is a precursor: it opens the capability gate for the next 2 turns and the control gate for the next 3.**

portfolio.name: Sovereign Inference Backbone
portfolio.description: A federated network of EU-controlled inference clusters, hardened and distributed, to host sovereign replicas from the Replication Foundry Initiative and enforce strict access controls on all high-capability AI use in public services

portfolio.name: Emergency Replication Mandate
portfolio.description: A binding directive requiring all public-sector AI deployments above capability level 55 to be mirrored within 90 days by a functionally equivalent model trained from open weights or independently verified checkpoints, using EU-controlled compute and staffed by EU-cleared personnel

portfolio.name: Sovereign Assurance Surge
portfolio.description: A crash programme to deploy independent, real-time monitoring and control systems on all replicated and frontier-adjacent AI in EU public services, using a combination of EU-certified interpretability tools, runtime telemetry, and mandatory red-teaming protocols enforced by the European AI Assurance Directorate (EAAD+)

portfolio.name: Public AI Observatory with Binding Telemetry Access
portfolio.description: A real-time public dashboard fed by mandatory telemetry from all high-capability AI systems operating in or affecting EU jurisdictions, with independent validation nodes hosted by member-state research institutes and civil society auditors granted read-only access to behavioural logs
